title: General Statutes of Connecticut, Title 31 (Labor), Chapter 557 — Employment Regulation
verified_how: fetched the register chapter page: heading 'CHAPTER 557 EMPLOYMENT REGULATION'; its table of contents lists Sec. 31-49e to 31-49i (Paid Family and Medical Leave Insurance Program, Authority and Trust Fund) and Sec. 31-51kk to 31-51pp (Family and medical leave), with Secs. 31-51cc to 31-51gg shown as the superseded earlier scheme.
notes: Connecticut's two leave regimes sit in one chapter: the job-protected CT FMLA (§§ 31-51kk et seq.) and the contributory Paid Family and Medical Leave Insurance Program (§§ 31-49e et seq.). Connecticut has no general statutory holiday-pay entitlement.
